header: Build next week's rota from last week's
bodytext:
The planner opens on last week, because most weeks look like the one before. Copy it forward and move the three shifts that changed. The checks run as you go: rest periods, contract hours, the trainee who may not close alone. Nothing waits until the end, when it is too late to fix.

Publishing sends the week to every phone at once and records who has seen it. After that, every change shows the old time next to the new one.
caption: The week planner, with the budget line at the bottom of the screen.

points.title: Copy last week forward
points.text: Two clicks. Then you only change the exceptions.

points.title: Checks while you plan
points.text: A shift that breaks a rule is refused at once, not reported on Monday.

points.title: One published version
points.text: Each later change shows the old time next to the new one.

image.alternative: Copper pipes and brass valves mounted on a concrete wall.
